from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys, time, hashlib
apk=Path("build/adb-install/2141d6f41816f70997df42b54bcc85b2c72a92c8/app-debug.apk")
if not apk.is_file() or apk.stat().st_size < 1_000_000:
    raise SystemExit("ERROR_CANONICAL_APK_MISSING")
print("APK_BYTES",apk.stat().st_size)
print("APK_SHA256",hashlib.sha256(apk.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
def adb(*args, timeout=90):
    return subprocess.run(["adb",*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
p=adb("devices","-l")
if p.returncode: raise SystemExit("ADB_DEVICES_FAILED")
connected=[]
for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
    parts=line.split()
    if len(parts) < 2 or parts[1]!="device": continue
    serial=parts[0]
    if "usb:" in line or (":" not in serial and not serial.startswith("emulator-")):
        connected.append(serial)
print("AUTHORIZED_USB_COUNT",len(connected))
if len(connected)!=1: raise SystemExit("NOT_EXACTLY_ONE_USB_DEVICE")
serial=connected[0]
def shell(*args):
    r=adb("-s",serial,"shell",*args)
    if r.returncode: raise SystemExit("ADB_SHELL_ERROR")
    return r.stdout.strip()
model=shell("getprop","ro.product.model")
print("MODEL",model)
if model!="SM-S906B":raise SystemExit("WRONG_MODEL_DO_NOT_INSTALL")
original_present=shell("pm","path","io.blueeye").startswith("package:")
print("APP_INSTALLED_BEFORE",original_present)
print("INSTALL_MODE","UPDATE_PRESERVE_DATA")
result=adb("-s",serial,"install","-r",str(apk.resolve()),timeout=240)
message=(result.stdout+" "+result.stderr).strip()
print("ADB_INSTALL_STATUS", "SUCCESS" if result.returncode==0 and "Success" in message else "FAILED")
if result.returncode or "Success" not in message:
    allowed=message.splitlines()[-3:]
    print("ADB_INSTALL_ERROR", " | ".join(allowed)[:650])
    print("APPLICATION_NOT_UNINSTALLED_DATA_PRESERVED")
    raise SystemExit(3)
installed=shell("pm","path","io.blueeye").startswith("package:")
print("PACKAGE_PRESENT_AFTER",installed)
if not installed:raise SystemExit("APP_PACKAGE_MISSING_AFTER_INSTALL")
launch=adb("-s",serial,"shell","am","start","-a","android.intent.action.MAIN","-c","android.intent.category.LAUNCHER","-p","io.blueeye",timeout=30)
print("LAUNCH_EXIT",launch.returncode)
print("LAUNCH_RESULT", "OK" if launch.returncode==0 and "Error" not in (launch.stdout+launch.stderr) else "FAILED")
time.sleep(3)
pid=shell("pidof","io.blueeye")
print("APP_PROCESS_RUNNING",bool(pid.strip()))
if launch.returncode!=0 or not pid.strip():raise SystemExit("INSTALL_OK_BUT_LAUNCH_NOT_CONFIRMED")
print("USB_INSTALL_AND_LAUNCH_PASS")
PY
